# Landing footer reference

Generated with the built-in imagegen tool before implementation on 2026-11-06.
Reference: [landing-footer-reference.png](landing-footer-reference.png).

## Prompt

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a large readable standalone desktop website FOOTER design reference, wide landscape 1440 by 480 composition. Mailloop SaaS site, white background, clean Plus Jakarta Sans typography, charcoal primary text, muted gray secondary text, restrained lavender wordmark gradient. Top full-width clearly visible 2px gray dotted separator. Content centered within 1180px with 56px gutters. Three columns: equal narrow side columns flanking a spacious center. LEFT Product heading with Templates, Contacts, Send queue, Allowances stacked at 14.5px. CENTER large bold lowercase "mailloop" wordmark, around 135px text size, centered exactly in footer, with "Personalized outreach, made easy." beneath at 14.5px. RIGHT Support and Legal groups side by side: Support with Help center, FAQ, Contact us; Legal with Privacy, Terms. Vertically center navigation groups with central brand. Generous top and bottom space around primary row, no cards, no CTA or buttons, no separate small logo. Under row a 2px gray dotted separator and compact utility row: left "© 2026 mailloop", middle tiny green status dot and "All systems running", right "Made by Czarl6". Preserve exact labels. Design reference only for this footer, no other page sections.

## Extraction and implementation

The wordmark is the dominant element, surrounded by equal side columns. The
navigation stays smaller, with bold headings and muted links. The tagline sits
beneath the wordmark, centered; both separators frame a compact utility row.
There are no cards, shadows, buttons or extra brand icons. Implementation uses a
1:2:1 grid, 32px gaps and 48px vertical padding. It keeps the existing 1180px
container, responsive gutters, 14px navigation headings and 14.5px links.

The reference guides spacing and alignment; existing semantic colors and the
canvas animation remain the source for theme rendering. Follow-up user requests
set both separators to 1px at 60% of the landing page’s muted lavender color and
match the light-mode wordmark fade to dark mode: purple uses 60% top/6% bottom opacity,
and the alternate light appearance uses black at 50% top/4% bottom. These
refinements supersede both the reference image and the earlier stronger
light-mode gradient (90%/60% purple, 85%/55% black).

The system-status dot and “All systems running” label were subsequently removed
by request. The utility row retains copyright and creator credit.

Subsequent layout refinements align the Product, Support and Legal headings at
the top and remove the utility-row separator, retaining the outer dotted line.
The final centering correction supersedes top-aligned headings: each desktop
navigation group is centered vertically against the wordmark itself, with the
tagline in a separate row beneath it.
